The whole Panel just for you

Outside the summer season we let the complex to one group at a time. You share the terrace, saunas and fire pit with no one. Ideal for family reunions, birthday parties, company team building, sports camps or weddings.

What's included

  • 5 apartments with bathroom; apartments 1–4 with kitchenette, crockery and sitting area – self-catering
  • Common room with fireplace, bar and beer tap for about 30 guests
  • Covered terrace with side curtains, 144 seats at tables, connected to the common room
  • Hot tub built into the stage
  • Finnish sauna, infrared sauna and relaxation room
  • Saltwater pool (May – September)
  • Large fire pit with seating and grill grate, free firewood
  • Children's playground
  • Free parking for 10 cars, 2 spaces with EV wallbox
  • Fenced complex, your dog can't run off
  • Ramp without steps to the pool and terrace
  • Darts and table football in the shared areas
  • All 4 rowing boats with oars to borrow for free
  • Wi-Fi in the accommodation area

Outside the season the complex is closed to the public: no snack bar, shop or events, and every space belongs to your group alone. A vending machine with drinks and small items is on the terrace.

What's charged separately

Handover, standard cleaning and bed linen are added to the booking automatically. Electricity is charged by actual consumption (including the infrared heating and any EV charging), and the tourist tax per municipal rules. You can bring your dog for free; just let us know when booking.

Terrace kiosk

For parties and weddings you can add a fully equipped terrace kiosk to your booking: coffee machine, beer tap, combi oven, dishwasher, deep fryer and more.
